answer_1.quote: we experiment with BART-based neural argument generators capable of generating factual argument text with distinct stances and argument schemes using control codes.
datasets: Parallel Corpus (PC) from Reddit, CommonCrawl, Webis
answer_1.outputs: Generated argument texts conditioned on stance and argument scheme, incorporating factual variables

answer_2.quote: Apart from comparing standard metrics like corpus BLEU and Rouge-L, we define the following metrics to evaluate each model. (i) Fact Faithfulness... (ii) Entailment... (iii) Contradiction...

answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation study using the evaluators from Section 3... The evaluators were asked to rate each generated argument text on the following five metrics. (i) Fluency... (ii) Stance Appropriateness... (iii) Scheme Appropriateness... (iv) Fact Faithfulness... (v) Logical Coherence...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators completed a worksheet with 50 random examples, rating each generated argument on fluency (1‑5), stance appropriateness (binary), scheme appropriateness (binary), fact faithfulness (1‑5), and logical coherence (1‑5). Inter‑annotator agreement was measured with Cohen's kappa.
